theater: 意大利半島（羅馬與拉文納）

battle.name: 歌德戰爭 (535年—554年)
battle.theater: 意大利半島（羅馬與拉文納）
battle.brief: 查士丁尼以阿瑪拉松塔母子遇害為由，於535年派貝利撒留渡海攻入意大利，十九年間三度圍羅馬，拉文納兩度易手，最後由納爾塞斯在塔奇奈與蒙斯・拉塔里烏斯兩役掃平東哥特王國。卡面這具秦弩不在此役戰場，它點出另一條規律：同一種儲力投射技術，地中海自有譜系，東西各自演進，不靠戰爭傳播。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰雙方是東羅馬帝國與意大利的東哥特王國。帝國方面由皇帝查士丁尼總攬，軍令自君士坦丁堡下達，戰區指揮分數層：535年查士丁尼任命貝利撒留為全軍統帥，只撥給七千五百人；另以內侍總管一級的將官分路用兵，穆恩杜斯取薩洛納、康斯坦提尼安努斯平定達爾馬提亞、納爾塞斯以御前會議成員身分率兵解圍。帝國軍是職業常備軍：步兵以小圓盾、札甲與鐵箍盔防護，弓手用塞種式複合弓，攻城配扭力弩砲與野驢砲，海上有可撞擊的鐵首海船，並徵用匈人、斯拉夫、赫魯利、倫巴第、庫特里古爾等外族傭兵。哥特方是一個由哥特戰士自備武器、以王室法庭為核心的民族王國：城市與稅制由羅馬人官僚維持，國王與忠誠者議會共同決策；536年即位的維提吉斯留四千人守羅馬、本人坐鎮拉文納，後由依里爾迪巴德、埃拉里克、托提拉、泰亞接續執政，並倚靠法蘭克人、勃艮第人與赫魯利傭兵。第三方角色使戰局更複雜：法蘭克與阿勒曼尼先是帝國盟友，553年卻大軍越過阿爾卑斯山入義；帝國一方則在551年的遠征軍中大量使用倫巴第、赫魯利與保加爾人。
countriesEn: The two parties in this war were the Eastern Roman Empire and the Ostrogothic Kingdom in Italy. On the imperial side the overall command lay with the emperor Justinian in Constantinople, and orders travelled down to the theatre through layers of authority: in 535 Justinian appointed Belisarius commander-in-chief of the expedition and gave him 7,500 men; other officers were assigned separate tasks, Mundus taking Salona, Constantinianus pacifying Dalmatia, and Narses, who served in the imperial chamber, bringing the relief of Ariminum. The imperial army was a professional standing force: infantry were protected by small round shields, scale armour and banded helmets, archers used Scythian composite bows, siege equipment comprised torsion ballistae and onagers, and the sea was served by iron-prowed rams, with large numbers of foreign auxiliaries and mercenaries - Huns, Slaavs, Heruli, Lombards, Cutrigurs - taken into imperial pay. The Gothic side was a national kingdom whose warriors equipped themselves and whose court of the king and the loyal ones formed the command centre: civil administration and taxation were run by Roman officials, in 536 the new king Vitiges left 4,000 men to hold Rome and sat in Ravenna himself, and he was succeeded in turn by Ildibad, Eraric, Totila and Teia, the kingdom also leaning on Frankish, Burgundian and Herulian mercenaries. The role of third parties made the war far more complex: Franks and Alemanni began as imperial allies but in 553 crossed the Alps in force, while the imperial side in turn hired large numbers of Lombards, Heruli and Bulgars for the expedition of 551.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩個政權。皇帝查士丁尼一世是發動者，他以534年阿瑪拉松塔母子被殺為由，把王位繼承糾紛改寫成帝國收復失地的法理依據；被殺的女王與十歲的國王阿塔拉里克，代表帝國推行的羅馬化政策。哥特一方：提奧達哈德曾向帝國求援，535年卻被自己人推翻；536年即位的維提吉斯坐鎮拉文納、以大軍圍困羅馬，539年米蘭陷落後轉向法蘭克人求援；依里爾迪巴德於541年五月被刺殺；魯吉亞人埃拉里克一度被推為王，卻打算把王國交給帝國，同年秋被殺；托提拉自541年秋起執政，以游擊與急行軍收回南意大利，並重整哥特騎兵的薩爾馬提安式射法；553年戰死的泰亞是最後一任哥特王。帝國將領中，貝利撒留名聲最盛，他以少兵奇襲奪羅馬與拉文納，又三次解羅馬之圍；納爾塞斯在542年被召回君士坦丁堡，551年再度領軍，以穩健的包抄贏下552年塔奇奈與553年蒙斯・拉塔里烏斯兩役，554年在羅馬舉行凱旋。參戰者還包括康斯坦提尼安努斯、穆恩杜斯、穆恩迪拉斯、出身亞美尼亞的所謂血腥者約翰、伊爾迪格、馬丁、貝薩斯、基普里安、瓦勒里安，以及赫魯利人指揮富爾卡里斯。最接近當事人的記錄，是曾任貝利撒留書記的普羅科匹烏斯所寫的《戰史》。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities span both states. Emperor Justinian I was the initiator: he turned a succession quarrel into a legal claim on Italy after the killing of Amalasuntha and her son in 534, and the murdered queen and the ten-year-old king Athalaric embodied the Romanising policy of the Empire. On the Gothic side Theodahad, who had asked the Empire for protection, was overthrown by his own men in 535; Vitiges, who took power in 536, held Ravenna, besieged Rome with massed troops, and after the fall of Milan in 539 turned to the Franks for help; Ildibad was assassinated in May 541; Eraric, a Rugian, was proclaimed king and then plotted to hand the kingdom over to the Empire, and was killed in the autumn of the same year; Totila, who assumed kingship in the autumn of 541, recovered southern Italy with mobile warfare and fast marches and restored the Sarmatian style of shooting from the saddle in the Gothic cavalry. Teia, who fell in 553, was the last Gothic king. Among the imperial generals, Belisarius carried the greatest fame: he took Rome and Ravenna by surprise with a handful of men and relieved Rome three times. Narses was summoned to Constantinople in 542 and led the last campaign from 551, winning Taginae in 552 and Mons Lactarius in 553 by a measured encirclement, and staged a triumph in Rome in 554. Others who took part were Constantinianus, Mundus, Mundilas, the Armenian-born John the Sanguinary, Ildiger, Martin, Bessas, Cyprian, Valerian and the Herulian commander Fulcaris. The closest eyewitness record is the History of the Wars written by Procopius, who served as Belisarius' secretary.
kits: 卡面所配的秦弩並未出現在意大利戰場；佢點出嘅唔係另一場戰爭，而係技術傳播嘅路徑問題。秦弩的形制自戰國以來定型：弩機把拉力存住，張弦之後不必再拉，射速遠勝拉弓，守城一方可以靠它把攻城者壓在牆外；漢代的神臂弓要靠多人合力絞張，東漢末至三國又出現以多具弩機相連的連弩。同一時期的中國，弩是北方邊塞與南方州郡守城的主兵器，敦煌出土的北涼至高昌時期裝備清冊上，弩與弩矢都是常見條目。地中海世界走的是另一條路：羅馬的弩機及其手弩型，自共和晚期沿用至晚期古代，四世紀的韋格蒂烏斯《兵法》仍有記載；拉文納聖維塔萊教堂的鑲嵌畫（約547年，與本役同時）裏面，一名帝國士兵手上正握着一具木製手弩；而野驢砲與大型弩砲則是攻城器械。歌德戰爭中，帝國與哥特兩邊都實際使用手弩：守方從城頭與塔樓射擊壓制攻城者，攻城方把手弩架在雲梯與臨時木塔上，瞄準城頭的射孔；普羅科匹烏斯屢次提到弩手參與攻守，549年托提拉猛攻羅馬臨時石牆時被擋退，靠的就是城頭的弩砲。545年貝利撒留解羅馬之圍時，還用火船燒毀哥特人在台伯河上架起的木橋與瞭望塔。同一戰場上常見的裝備還包括塞種式複合弓、哥特人的長劍與長矛、拜占庭的短投槍、鐵箍盔與札甲，以及各式攻城槌、雲梯與炊具車。卡面這件武器提醒的是另一回事：秦弩與地中海手弩係兩套並行咗好耐嘅技術，唔係一次戰爭傳過去嘅；同一種儲力原理，喺中國變成北方邊塞同州郡城頭嘅壓制器械，喺意大利變成牆頭與雲梯上嘅手弩，真正嘅分水嶺唔喺機括，而喺兩邊嘅城市兵工同糧食供應，而義大利嗰年恰恰缺呢兩樣。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card never appeared on an Italian battlefield; what it points to is not another war but the question of how technology travels. The form of the Chinese crossbow was settled as early as the Warring States period: the trigger mechanism stores the draw force, so no further pulling is needed after cocking, and the rate of fire far exceeds that of a bow, which lets the defenders of a city hold the attackers down outside the walls. The strong crossbow of the Han needed several men to cock it by leverage, and from the late Han and the Three Kingdoms period there appeared the repeating crossbow, built from several crossbow mechanisms coupled together. In China of the same age the crossbow was the principal missile weapon of the northern frontier forts and of the southern commanderies and prefectures, and on the equipment tallies excavated at Dunhuang from the Northern Liang down to the Gaochang period both crossbows and crossbow bolts are common entries. The Mediterranean world followed a different line: the Roman ballista and its hand crossbow forms were in use from the late Republic into late antiquity, Vegetius still describes them in the fourth century, and in the mosaic in San Vitale at Ravenna, dated to about 547 and therefore contemporary with this war, one of the imperial soldiers is shown holding a wooden hand crossbow; the onager and the large ballista served as siege engines. In the Gothic War both the imperial and the Gothic sides actually used hand crossbows: the defenders fired them from the walls and towers to pin the assault, and the besiegers mounted them on siege ladders and improvised wooden towers, aiming at the embrasures; Procopius repeatedly mentions crossbowmen taking part in attack and defence, and when Totila stormed the hastily rebuilt walls of Rome in 549 it was the wall ordnance that held him off. In 545, relieving Rome, Belisarius also burned down the wooden bridge and watchtowers the Goths had thrown across the Tiber with fire boats. Other equipment constantly seen on the same battlefield included Scythian composite bows, the long sword and long lance of the Goths, the light throwing spear of the Byzantines, banded helmets and scale armour, and a great variety of battering rams, siege ladders and supply wagons. What the card records is a different point: the Chinese crossbow and the Mediterranean hand crossbow were two systems that ran in parallel for a long time, and no single war carried one into the other. The same principle of stored force became, in China, the weapon that held the northern frontier forts and the prefectural city walls down, and in Italy the hand crossbow on the walls and on the siege ladders; the real dividing line lay not in the trigger but in the city workshops and the food supply on each side, and Italy in those years lacked exactly those two things.
tactics: 帝國方面的打法可以歸納為三種。首選是海陸並進的奇襲：536年貝利撒留先取西西里，隨後自雷焦登陸，圍困那不勒斯約三週後破城，再於12月9日未遇抵抗進入羅馬。其次是以城市為堡壘的消耗與襲擾：537年3月至538年3月的第一次羅馬之圍，貝利撒留放棄野戰，靠城牆、弩砲與當地徵召的守軍頂住遠多於己方的哥特大軍；帝國海軍切斷哥特人的海上補給，匈人與斯拉夫的一千六百名騎射手則不斷出城襲擾。第三是分割敵軍、多路合擊：解阿里米努姆之圍時他把兵分三路，伊爾迪格率海路、馬丁自南面，主力由他與納爾塞斯自西北逼近，逼得維提吉斯放棄羅馬北撤。攻方也有可資比較的手段：托提拉刻意避開會戰，以快速機動奪取城邑，破城後拆毀城牆使其失去防衛價值，並以善待守軍、准許投降換取人心，542至543年間重新取得南意大利的臣服。553至554年，納爾塞斯在沃爾圖諾河畔以步兵列陣扛住法蘭克人的正面衝撞，再以騎兵完成包圍殲滅。補給線上，帝國靠西西里與阿非利加的糧船維持，哥特人則在海上攔截；托提拉建起一支足以挑戰帝國海軍的艦隊，551年塞納・加利卡海戰才被裝備與協同更好的帝國水手擊敗。糧食是攻城與守城的共同瓶頸，烏爾比努斯因唯一泉眼乾涸而陷落，米蘭守軍因缺糧在539年屈服。
tacticsEn: The imperial method can be reduced to three patterns. The first was a surprise by sea and land together: in 536 Belisarius first took Sicily, then crossed from Rhegium, breached Naples after a siege of roughly three weeks, and entered Rome on 9 December without meeting resistance. The second was to hold the city and wear the enemy down: in the first siege of Rome, from March 537 to March 538, Belisarius gave up the battle in the open and relied on the walls, the artillery and locally raised garrison troops to withstand a Gothic army far larger than his own; the imperial navy cut the Goths' supply by sea, while sixteen hundred Hunnic and Slaavic mounted archers rode out of the city again and again to harry them. The third was to divide the enemy and strike from several quarters: when relieving Ariminum he split his force three ways, Ildiger by sea, Martin from the south, and the main body under himself and Narses from the north-west, which forced Vitiges to abandon Rome and fall back. The attackers had comparable devices: Totila deliberately avoided pitched battle, seizing cities by fast manoeuvre, razed the walls of places he took so that they could no longer be defended, and won men over by treating garrisons well and accepting surrenders, recovering the submission of southern Italy between 542 and 543. In 553 and 554, at the Volturnus, Narses held the Franks' frontal charge with his infantry line and then completed the destruction with an encircling cavalry movement. On the logistic side the Empire drew its grain from Sicily and Africa while the Goths intercepted it at sea; Totila built a fleet capable of challenging the imperial navy, and it was not defeated until the battle of Sena Gallica in 551, when the better drilled imperial sailors won. Food was the common bottleneck of siege and defence: Urbinus fell because its one spring dried up, and the garrison of Milan capitulated in 539 for want of grain.
data: 兵員與時間：查士丁尼最初只給貝利撒留七千五百人，遠少於對付汪達爾時的規模；537年4月自君士坦丁堡抵達的一千六百名匈人與斯拉夫騎射手、年底抵達的五千援兵，以及分給所謂血腥者約翰的兩千騎兵，先後填補缺口；納爾塞斯解阿里米努姆時帶五千人，另有兩千赫魯利人加盟；占領米蘭時只派出一千人。哥特方面的數字多由普羅科匹烏斯記錄，往例被認為有所誇大：圍羅馬的大軍記為十五萬人，539年越過阿爾卑斯山的是法蘭克王都德貝爾特率領的十萬人，553年入侵的法蘭克與阿勒曼尼聯軍記為七萬五千人；托提拉在法文提亞作戰時出動五千人，549至550年羅馬守軍只有三千，553至555年在坎普薩堅守的哥特人為七千。時間軸上，535年查士丁尼下令任命統帥，536年11月破那不勒斯，536年12月9日入羅馬，537年3月至538年3月第一次羅馬之圍，539年3月底米蘭陷落、同年秋冬奧克西莫斯與菲耶索萊投降，540年5月拉文納易手，542年大疫，543年那不勒斯有條件投降，545至547年第二次羅馬攻防，546年12月17日托提拉入羅馬，549至550年第三次羅馬之圍，551年海戰與遠征軍集結，552年塔奇奈，553年10月蒙斯・拉塔里烏斯，554年沃爾圖諾河，555年春坎普薩投降，562年維羅納與布里克斯最後淪陷。前後合計十九年。損失方面，539年法蘭克軍在波河兩岸失利後又因痢疾折損約三分之一，553至554年入侵的兩支部族聯軍在沃爾圖諾河幾乎全滅；帝國與哥特兩軍的具體陣亡數字已無可核對的記載，只留下城市被拆平、耕地荒蕪的後果。至於卡面那具秦弩，它並不在此役的戰場上：現場有的是羅馬式手弩與弩砲，儲力機括同秦弩同源而器物不同。
dataEn: Men and dates: Justinian gave Belisarius only 7,500 men at the outset, far fewer than he had brought against the Vandals; the sixteen hundred Hunnic and Slaavic mounted archers who reached Italy from Constantinople in April 537, the five thousand reinforcements who arrived by the end of the year, and the two thousand horsemen given to John the Sanguinary filled the gaps in turn; Narses brought five thousand men to the relief of Ariminum and was joined by two thousand Heruli; only a thousand men were used to occupy Milan. The Gothic figures come mostly from Procopius and are customarily regarded as inflated: the army besieging Rome is put at 150,000, the force that crossed the Alps in 539 was the hundred thousand of the Frankish king Theudebert, and the invading league of Franks and Alemanni in 553 is recorded at seventy-five thousand; Totila brought five thousand men to the field of Faventia, the garrison of Rome in 549-550 numbered only three thousand, and the Goths who held out at Campsa counted seven thousand until 555. The chronology runs: the appointment in 535, the fall of Naples in November 536, the entry into Rome on 9 December 536, the first siege of Rome from March 537 to March 538, the loss of Milan at the end of March 539 with the surrender of Auximus and Fiesole in the autumn and winter of the same year, the change of hands at Ravenna in May 540, the great plague of 542, the conditional surrender of Naples in 543, the second Roman campaign of 545-547, Totila's entry into Rome on 17 December 546, the third siege of Rome in 549-550, the naval battle and the assembly of the expeditionary force in 551, Taginae in 552, Mons Lactarius in October 553, the Volturnus in 554, the capitulation at Campsa in the spring of 555, and the final loss of Verona and Brixia in 562. The war therefore ran nineteen years from end to end. On losses, the Frankish army was defeated on both banks of the Po in 539 and then lost about a third of its strength to dysentery, while the two barbarian contingents that invaded in 553-554 were practically wiped out at the Volturnus; no verifiable record of the numbers killed in the imperial and Gothic armies survives, only the consequences, razed cities and abandoned fields. As for the crossbow on the card, it was not on this battlefield: what stood there was the Roman hand crossbow and the wall ordnance, sharing the principle of stored force with the Chinese weapon while differing in every particular of the instrument.
cause: 直接導火線是王位繼承上的殺人事件。526年提奧德里克大帝去世，十歲的阿塔拉里克繼位，其母阿瑪拉松塔攝政；她在位期間向元老院靠攏、允許帝國海軍使用西西里的港口，甚至致書查士丁尼求庇護，令哥特貴族不安。533年查士丁尼頒布《查士丁尼敕令》，宣布羅馬人與元老院可以自由選舉意大利的皇帝，等於替帝國干預意大利預留了法理通道。534年阿塔拉里克病死，阿瑪拉松塔把王位讓給表兄提奧達哈德，後者卻在535年囚禁並殺死母子，把她向帝國求援的信當作把柄。查士丁尼隨即以為阿瑪拉松塔復仇為名出兵。更深層的原因是帝國的擴張意圖：533至534年汪達爾戰爭的迅速勝利讓君士坦丁堡相信西部的蠻族王國並非不可摧毀；而提奧德里克建立的雙軌體制，哥特人握軍、羅馬人管政，始終隔著阿里烏斯派與迦克墩派的宗教分歧和稅制摩擦，意大利的貴族、教會與城市在三十年間已形成請帝國介入的傾向。帝國方面的另一項準備是財政與法律：533年完成的《民法大全》提供了法理工具，534年後的財政改革與新稅制則為長期戰爭提供了錢糧。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was a killing over the succession. Theodoric the Great died in 526, the ten-year-old Athalaric succeeded him, and his mother Amalasuntha governed as regent; she moved towards the Senate, allowed the imperial fleet to use the harbours of Sicily, and even wrote to Justinian asking for refuge, which alarmed the Gothic nobles. In 533 Justinian issued the Edictum Constantini, declaring that the Romans and the Senate might elect an emperor of their own for Italy, so opening a legal path for imperial intervention. Athalaric died in 534 and Amalasuntha handed the kingship to her cousin Theodahad, who imprisoned and killed mother and son in 535 and turned her appeal to the Empire against her. Justinian thereupon went to war in the name of avenging Amalasuntha. The deeper reason was the Empire's appetite for expansion: the swift victory in the Vandal War of 533-534 persuaded Constantinople that the barbarian kingdoms of the west were not invulnerable, while the dual system established by Theodoric, Goths holding the army and Romans running the state, had never shaken off the friction of the religious division between the Arian and the Chalcedonian churches and of the tax regime, and over three decades the nobles, the churches and the cities of Italy had formed a habit of appealing to the Empire. On the imperial side the preparations were financial and legal as well: the Corpus Juris Civilis completed in 533 supplied the legal instrument, and the fiscal reform and the new taxes after 534 provided the money and the grain for a long war.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了意大利的形貌，也改變了帝國的財政與邊界。第一，東哥特作為一個政治共同體消失了：托提拉與泰亞相繼戰死，哥特王國的制度、軍隊編制與王權儀式全部解體，倖存的哥特人有的被俘後編入帝國東方軍團，有的留在原地成為帝國臣民，其餘在往後數十年裡散入帝國各地。553至554年法蘭克與阿勒曼尼的失敗，使意大利在568年倫巴德人入侵前維持了三年的帝國秩序，但殘破的經濟已無法支撐長期防守，帝國最終只保住拉文納總督區的狹長地帶。第二，意大利的城市網與農業遭到重創，水渠、橋梁、田圃荒廢，羅馬與米蘭的人口遠低於戰前，後世學者多稱之為慘勝；帝國為此耗盡的軍費與稅收，被視為同期防禦多瑙河北岸與西亞前線的資源轉移。第三，羅馬教會的角色上升：戰爭中教宗維吉里烏斯避往西西里，535年召開的強盜會議與其後的教宗政治，使教皇在帝國、教宗與蠻族的三方關係中取得新的籌碼；元老院的傳統特權則在554年的《實務詔令》下被重新編排，地方行政與稅收轉由帝國官僚接管。第四，軍事上這場戰爭成為晚期羅馬野戰的教科書：貝利撒留的奇襲與解圍、納爾塞斯的兩翼包抄，以及圍城與反圍城的攻防細節，都被普羅科匹烏斯逐日記錄，後世拜占庭關於戰爭藝術的爭論多以此為引。
impactEn: This war changed the shape of Italy and the finances and frontiers of the Empire. First, the Ostrogoths ceased to exist as a political community: Totila and Teia were killed in turn, the institutions, the army system and the ceremonial of the Gothic kingship were all dismantled, and those who survived were either taken prisoner and enrolled in the imperial eastern armies or left in place as imperial subjects, while the rest were scattered across the Empire over the following decades. The defeat of the Franks and Alemanni in 553-554 left Italy under imperial order for the three years before the Lombards came in 568, but an economy too ruined to support a long defence could not be held, and the Empire was ultimately left with only the narrow strip of the Exarchate of Ravenna. Second, the network of cities and the agriculture of Italy were ruined: aqueducts, bridges and fields fell out of use, the populations of Rome and Milan stood far below their pre-war numbers, and later scholars commonly call the outcome a Pyrrhic victory; the military cost and the taxes drained from the Empire are seen as resources transferred away from the Danube and the western Asian frontiers. Third, the role of the Roman church grew: the pope Vigilius took refuge in Sicily during the war, the synod of 535 held under imperial pressure and the later papal politics gave the pontiff new leverage in the triangle of Empire, papacy and barbarian rulers, while the traditional privileges of the Senate were recast under the Pragmatic Sanction of 554, with local administration and taxation handed to imperial officials. Fourth, militarily the war became a textbook of late Roman field operations: Belisarius' surprise attacks and relieves, Narses' envelopment, and the detailed business of siege and counter-siege were all recorded day by day by Procopius, and later Byzantine debates about the conduct of war cite him constantly.
result: 結局是東哥特王國的徹底解體，但代價慘重。540年5月拉文納在帝國海軍封鎖與外交欺騙下易手，維提吉斯被授為帝國執政官，俘虜被送入東方軍團；541年托提拉即位後，帝國在意大利的統治幾乎崩潰，直到551年查士丁尼任命納爾塞斯為遠征軍主帥。552年塔奇奈之戰，納爾塞斯以縱深配置與預設在側翼的兵力擊潰托提拉的王室騎兵，托提拉重傷而亡；553年10月蒙斯・拉塔里烏斯之戰，餘下的哥特人被消滅，泰亞傷重身亡，成為最後一任哥特王。553至554年越過阿爾卑斯山的法蘭克與阿勒曼尼聯軍在沃爾圖諾河被全殲，坎普薩的哥特守軍在555年春投降，維羅納與布里克斯堅守到562年。554年查士丁尼頒布《實務詔令》，重劃意大利的稅收與行政，並在羅馬為納爾塞斯舉行凱旋典禮，後世視之為晚期羅馬最後一次大型凱旋。戰爭的戰術成果因此固定下來：帝國重新控制意大利中部與南部，但北部長期淪於法蘭克、勃艮第與後來倫巴德人之手，拉文納總督區與教宗領地並存的局面由此開始；568年倫巴德人入據意大利，也被視為這場戰爭的直接後果之一。貝利撒留在戰後被召回並遭罷黜，最終病逝於562至565年間；納爾塞斯以高齡出任執政官，但四年後亦遭流放。
resultEn: The outcome was the total dissolution of the Ostrogothic Kingdom at heavy cost. Ravenna changed hands in May 540 under the naval blockade of the Empire and a diplomatic deception, Vitiges was granted the rank of an imperial patrician, and the prisoners were sent into the eastern armies; after Totila took the throne in 541, imperial rule in Italy very nearly collapsed, until Justinian appointed Narses commander of the expeditionary force in 551. At Taginae in 552 Narses broke the royal cavalry of Totila with a deep deployment and a force held back on the flank, and Totila was fatally wounded; at Mons Lactarius in October 553 the remaining Goths were destroyed and Teia, mortally hit, became the last Gothic king. The league of Franks and Alemanni that crossed the Alps in 553-554 was annihilated at the Volturnus, the Gothic garrison at Campsa capitulated in the spring of 555, and Verona and Brixia held out until 562. In 554 Justinian promulgated the Pragmatic Sanction, redrawing the taxation and administration of Italy, and a triumph was staged in Rome for Narses, regarded in later ages as the last great Roman triumph. The tactical result was thus fixed: the Empire regained central and southern Italy, but the north remained for long in the hands of Franks, Burgundians and later Lombards, and the arrangement of a Ravenna exarchate alongside papal territory began here. The Lombard entry into Italy in 568 is also read as a direct consequence of this war. Belisarius was recalled and disgraced after the war and died between 562 and 565; Narses, at a great age, was made consul, but was exiled four years later.
